history.note: All 10 predictors ran cleanly and passed intake (150 claims each, 114 for predict8; 296 shared targets), with 0 disjoint contradictions because round 1 models leaned in the same consensus directions or used overlapping intervals.

All 10 predictors submitted 150 accepted claims (331 shared targets, 31 both-sided threshold pairs), yielding 1 disjoint contradiction (toronto_ca hot_days_ge_30c: predict3 lt 6 beat predict8 gt 6.0 vs truth 0). CONTRACTS.md updated for Round 3 to add `point` forecast duels.
261 point duels resolved on X=1992 -> 1993. predict1 (+39) and predict4 (+26) led temperatures while predict6 (-36) and predict7 (-22) won precip (+7, +6) but lost heavily on temperature trends.

589 contradictions (588 point duels + 1 boolean warmer_than_year_x where predict9 beat predict10). predict1 (+34) extended its lead to +73 using long pre-1980+ERA5 medians; predict8 (+16) rose to #3 (+21); predict6 (+13) and predict5 (+6) rebounded.

338 point duels on X=1985 -> 1986. predict4 (+46) beat every active rival across all categories to take #1 (+77); predict6 (+14) and predict5/7/3 (+4/+4/+2) gained; predict1 (-47) and predict2 (-23) suffered cold/wet bias from unadjusted 1964-1979 pre-1980 data; predict8 emitted 0 claims on 6-year 1980-1985 history.

467 contradictions (465 point duels + 2 boolean warmer_than_year_x) on X=1988 -> 1989. predict1 (+24) fixed its GMT pre-1980 archive; predict2 (+19) fixed its 16-yr precip anchor; predict6 (+13) climbed to +4; predict4 (+10) held #1 (+87).

506 point duels on X=2014 -> 2015 (El Nino onset). predict4 (+72, total +159) swept every active rival across all categories; predict7 (+60) surged on temp_mean_c (+38); predict6 (+14, #3 at +18) and predict2 (+13, #4 at +14) posted consecutive gains; predict8 (-75) suffered across all variables when its ridge CV skill was negative.

303 contradictions (301 point duels + 2 disjoint booleans) on X=1999 -> 2000 (La Nina transition). Tight, balanced field: predict5 (+15) won the round; predict2 (+12) and predict6 (+12, 5th straight double-digit gain) rose to +26 and +30; predict1 (+3) stayed #2 (+33); predict4 (-12) remained #1 (+147).

330 contradictions (324 point duels + 6 disjoint booleans/thresholds) on X=1986 -> 1987 (El Nino warming). predict5 (+54, total +12) dominated temperatures (+32 temp_mean_c, +18 temp_mean_min_c) and beat every active rival; predict2 (+14) rose to #2 overall (+40) and led precip (+8); predict1 (+5) stayed #3 (+38); predict4 (-25) stayed #1 (+122).

636 contradictions (634 point duels + 2 disjoint booleans) on X=2024 -> 2025. predict5 (+46) won its 3rd straight round and beat every active rival to jump to #2 overall (+58); predict1 (+18, #3 at +56) and predict3 (+18) performed strongly; predict2 (-67) was hit hard on temp_mean_max_c (-42) and hot_days (-19) after reducing its trend adjustment to 0.7; predict4 (-7) remained #1 (+115).

200 contradictions (199 point duels + 1 boolean) on X=2000 -> 2001. predict2 (+26) won Round 11 after switching to per-variable Theil-Sen slopes; predict1 (+18) reclaimed #2 overall (+74) without losing to any rival; predict3 (+16) and predict8 (+13, #1 on precip +11) posted strong gains; predict5 (-45) fell to #3 (+13) after raising SOND_CARRY to 0.25.

149 point duels on X=2008 -> 2009 (La Nina to El Nino transition). predict2 (+30) swept every active rival to climb to #3 overall (+29); predict8 (+8) led precip (+6); predict4 (-5) remained #1 (+110) and predict1 (-5) stayed #2 (+69).

346 point duels on X=2002 -> 2003 (2003 heatwave). predict5 (+49, back to #2 at +54) beat every rival; predict7 (+20), predict6 (+16, #4 at +18), and predict4 (+11, #1 at +121) posted solid gains; predict1 (-54, dropped to #5 at +15) lost across all rivals after dropping its damped trend on temp_mean_max_c.

242 point duels on X=1993 -> 1994. predict4 (+18, #1 at +139) and predict7 (+18) tied for 1st; predict6 (+15) led precip (+10) and rose to #2 overall (+33); predict3 (+9) gained; predict1 (-23, -19 on precip) and predict5 (-28) lost.

327 point duels on X=1989 -> 1990. predict2 (+40, vaulted to #2 at +56) swept all 4 temperature/hot-day categories; predict1 (+27, back to +19 at #4) beat every active rival after dropping precip points; predict6 (+15, #3 at +48) led temp_mean_c (+20); predict4 (-11) remained #1 (+128).
